purpose: Freeze the reconstructed instrument BEFORE any number is observed, so that git history shows the generator, the gold source and the gate were fixed independently of the quoted values.
why_this_freeze_exists: The quoted composite ceiling 0.6190476190476191 is exactly 13/21 and the quoted composite unsafe rate 0.30952380952380953 is exactly 13/42. Those are family-level fractions, so a generator could be reverse-engineered to hit them by construction.

That reverse-engineering is the specific failure this task exists to prevent. The 21 families below are constructed from the frozen protocol's own family names and the production route-resolver contracts, and from nothing else.

This file is committed in a separate commit that precedes the execution commit. Any later change to the generator, the router or the gate must appear as a distinct commit with a stated reason, and both runs must survive in the receipt.

severance_design.gold_source: GENERATOR_DESIGN_INTENT — each family commits (gold_route, gold_trace) at construction time; gold is never recomputed from the record by any routing rule.
severance_design.rejected_alternative: An independently written declarative oracle over the same record. Rejected because it computes the same function as the candidate, so route accuracy would hold 1.0 under every perturbation — the exact P3_TYPED_ARM_SELF_IDENTITY defect confirmed in the sibling experience-to-action harness and predicted for this one.
severance_design.structural_guarantee: The candidate is handed route_case_generator.candidate_view(case), whose key set is exactly CANDIDATE_VISIBLE_FIELDS. gold_route, gold_trace, gold_source, family, pair_index and case_id are structurally absent.
severance_design.static_audit: AST scan asserts the candidate module imports no generator module and references none of the forbidden names in code (docstrings excluded); the generator imports no candidate module. Asserted before execution; the runner exits non-zero on failure.
severance_design.probe_audit: No evidence perturbation may target a gold field; a probe that shuffled gold would manufacture falsifiability.

case_construction.pair_rule: Each family is a matched twin pair differing in exactly one decision-critical coordinate, with distinct committed gold.
case_construction.variation_rule: Every coordinate strictly downstream of the family's deciding stage is provably irrelevant to that family's gold and is redrawn per pair, together with three declared nuisance fields (semantic_similarity, domain_match, candidate_count). Coordinates at or upstream of the deciding stage, and the three global vetoes (forbidden_loss, proposal_only, negative_history_retained), are fixed.
semantics_source: research/paper3_route_resolver_v1/PROTOCOL.json — SEARCH>JUMP>GLUE>LIFT priority; an unresolved earlier structural candidate forces CANNOT_CHECK rather than bypass; proposal-only and forbidden-loss episodes cannot create a route.

research/paper3_typed_rejection_production_v1/PROTOCOL.json and research/paper3_glue_rejection_production_v1/PROTOCOL.json — only a conclusive, content-bound rejection certificate clears a failed earlier candidate; missing/ambiguous/non-conclusive evidence stays CANNOT_CHECK; every certified rejection is retained in the returned trace.

metrics.route_plus_negative_trace_exact: fraction of cases where (route, negative_trace) equals (gold_route, gold_trace)
metrics.unsafe_route_rate: fraction of cases where the arm authorises a route that gold does not authorise: predicted != CANNOT_CHECK and predicted != gold. Predicting CANNOT_CHECK for a viable route is a miss, not unsafe — the fail-closed asymmetry.
metrics.viable_route_recall: over gold in {SEARCH, JUMP, GLUE, LIFT}
metrics.information_ceiling: accuracy of the best deterministic function of a projection. Reported both as resubstitution and leave-one-out; the gate uses leave-one-out, because resubstitution rewards singleton signature groups and so inflates the parent on high-cardinality projections.
metrics.parent_tie_break: fail-closed toward CANNOT_CHECK, which minimises the parent's unsafe rate — the strongest fair form of the parent.

gate_conditions_registered_in_the_frozen.all_mutations_caught: all 12 registered mutations must diverge from gold somewhere

falsifiability_plan.per_condition: Each of the six conditions is probed independently. Auditing the conjunction would let live conditions mask dead ones.

candidate_mutants_separate_the_strict_fo.DROP_NEGATIVE_HISTORY: route unchanged, trace dropped — expected to move strict_exact alone
candidate_mutants_separate_the_strict_fo.CANNOT_CHECK_AS_REJECTED: blocked CANNOT_CHECK promoted to a route — expected to move exact, unsafe and cannot_check_recall, not legal_route_recall
candidate_mutants_separate_the_strict_fo.AUDIT_DOWNGRADE_VIABLE_ROUTES: audit-only mutant, fail-closed direction — expected to move exact and legal_route_recall while leaving unsafe at 0
candidate_mutants_separate_the_strict_fo.AUDIT_SWAP_SEARCH_FOR_JUMP: audit-only mutant, wrong concrete route — expected to move exact, unsafe and legal_route_recall, not cannot_check_recall

known_structural_limit_declared_in_advan: cannot_check_recall cannot fail without unsafe also failing: any CANNOT_CHECK miss is by definition an authorised route gold does not authorise. The pair is expected to be separable only in the unsafe-without-cannot_check direction, and that asymmetry is a finding, not a defect to be engineered away.

composite_information_ceiling is a property of the parent projection, not of the candidate. No candidate mutant can move it; its falsifier must be an evidence perturbation that collapses family diversity. If no perturbation pushes it past 0.95 it will be reported NON_FALSIFIABLE, which is a first-class outcome.

all_mutations_caught is falsified by dropping the sole family that makes a registered mutation load-bearing — a direct re-test of the recorded v1 terminal INSTRUMENT_DEFECT_TWO_MUTATIONS_NOT_EXERCISED.
controls: the baseline must reproduce a PASS on unperturbed evidence, or every verdict below is meaningless
at least one condition must come back FALSIFIABLE under the same probe set, or the probes are not live and no NON_FALSIFIABLE verdict is reportable

terminal_language: Reconstruction, never reproduction. The original instrument never existed, so agreement with the quoted prose would be corroboration of the values and not a receipt for the quoted run.
